summary: Verified auth security overhaul: BUG #1 (logout server-side JTI revocation) and BUG #2 (forgot-password real Brevo email + reset flow) both work end-to-end. 12/12 backend pytest tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_auth_security.py. Playwright confirmed logout redirects to /login and browser Back button does NOT restore protected page (window.location.replace + auth guard). Forgot-password page shows neutral 'Si el correo corresponde...' message. Brevo logs confirm real HTTP 201 Created responses to https://api.brevo.com/v3/smtp/email. Rate limit 5→429 verified; successful login clears counter. HttpOnly + Secure + SameSite=None cookie verified on /api/auth/login. Full regression flow (login→client→loan→pay→dashboard) still passes.

ui_bugs.issue: Password input has HTML attribute minLength={6} but the real backend/JS policy is 8 chars. Browsers show native tooltip 'lengthen to 6 characters' before the JS validation toast can fire. Set minLength={8} to match policy.

action_items: Optional: change /app/frontend/src/pages/Register.jsx line 53 minLength={6} -> minLength={8} for consistency with policy.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L947-954: CORSMiddleware uses allow_credentials=True with allow_origins=['*'] AND allow_origin_regex='.*'. Spec-wise browsers reject wildcard + credentials. Cookie-based auth relies on this being permissive for the preview host; works today because starlette echoes back the request Origin when regex matches, but pin an explicit origin list for production.

server.py L124-126: set_auth_cookie uses samesite='none' + secure=True. Good for cross-origin, but on http:// dev this cookie is silently dropped. Frontend also stores JWT in localStorage so Bearer works — dual-path is fine.
server.py L128-154 get_current_user: correctly checks JTI and revoked_at. Session lookup is per-request DB call — acceptable but consider a short cache if scale grows.
server.py L295-301 logout: does not require the *matching* session to be active — will still 200 if user re-uses a token that was already revoked (Depends re-validates so this is fine). OK.

server.py L308-337 forgot: correctly neutral response regardless of whether user exists (no timing side-channel on Brevo call because it's awaited inside the `if user:` branch — small timing gap possible; acceptable).
server.py L339-354 reset: revokes all outstanding sessions after password change. Good.

server.py L108-122 rate-limit: counts failed attempts in a rolling 15-min window, successful login deletes the failed rows. Works. Minor: no IP-based limit (only email), so attacker can enumerate users across different emails from same IP without a global brake.

server.py L279-293 login: `check_rate_limit` runs BEFORE password verification (good — prevents bypass) but is silent for legit users who mistype 5×. Consider CAPTCHA or exponential backoff response header.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth security suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_auth_security.py (12 tests, all green). It hits Brevo — expect a real email to nutricrispy@gmail.com per full run. Existing regressions in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py continue to work. Frontend logout uses window.location.replace so Playwright must reload after logout to assert.
rca_of_the_issue: BUG #1 root cause was that JWT-only auth had no server-side session store, so logout was a client-side no-op. Fix: JTI claim in token + db.sessions collection + revoked_at timestamp checked in get_current_user. Verified working. BUG #2 root cause was that forgot-password only logged to console. Fix: real httpx POST to Brevo /v3/smtp/email with API key from env. Verified via backend log 'HTTP/1.1 201 Created'.
